messages.subject: dataProcess(): Error in vecseq(f__, len__, if (allow.cartesian || notjoin || !anyDuplicated(f__,  :
parts:
Hello MSstats team!

I was running my own data through MSstats and after formatting my input dataframe I decided I was ready for the next step, but I ran into this error:

dataProcess(k)
=====
Error in vecseq(f__, len__, if (allow.cartesian || notjoin || !anyDuplicated(f__,  :
  Join results in 468660615 rows; more than 180464 = nrow(x)+nrow(i). Check for duplicate key values in i each of which join to the same group in x over and over again. If that's ok, try by=.EACHI to run j for each group to avoid the large allocation. If you are sure you wish to proceed, rerun with allow.cartesian=TRUE. Otherwise, please search for this error message in the FAQ, Wiki, Stack Overflow and data.table issue tracker for advice.

I have seen this post from this group, as well as this thread and this thread from another repo about this error, but both of them did not solve my problem, at least from what I have tried.

I would love some help on how to tackle this!

MSstats: Version 4.6.5
R version: 4.2.1

Please let me know if you require any additional information.
